intro: Sign in to your team’s workspace to manage access and keep your settings in order.
note: Access is limited to enrolled workspace members.
signinIntro: Enter the workspace ID shared by your team. You’ll continue to your organization’s sign-in provider.
signinFailed: Sign-in could not be completed. Check your workspace ID and membership, then try again.
unavailable: The workspace is unavailable. Please try again.
expired: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
forbidden: Your membership no longer permits access. Contact your workspace owner.
conflict: The workspace changed since you opened it. Refresh to review the latest settings before trying again.
limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment, then try again.
invalid: These settings could not be saved. Review your entry.
refreshRequired: Refresh the workspace before making another change.
suspendedNote: This workspace is suspended. Its data is retained. An owner can resume access below.
name: Workspace name
readOnly: Only a workspace owner can change these settings.
lifecycleIntro: Suspending a workspace blocks ordinary access. Owners can still sign in here to resume it. Data is retained.
suspendDetail: Ordinary access will stop. Data will be retained, and owners can still sign in to resume the workspace.
resumeDetail: Enrolled members will be able to access this workspace again.
sessionHint: This browser is signed in to this workspace.
signoutNote: This ends Karate sessions. Your organization’s sign-in session may remain active.
nameHint: Choose a name between 1 and 120 characters.
